answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. A pulse of per-task receipts records who did what, and the wharf of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the vertex is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
